title: SAGE Vault Configuration
description: Top-level vault configuration schema. A domain instantiation produces a single YAML file that validates against this schema. Sub-schemas are referenced for document types, lifecycle, source adapters, metadata extraction, and edge inference. See SAGE Architecture Reference Sections 4.7, 7.2, and 8.3.

id.description: Vault identifier. Unique within the CAS installation.

name.description: Human-readable display name for this vault.

description.description: Optional free-text description of this vault's purpose, surfaced in vault-listing UIs (e.g., the CAS Application dashboard). Null or absent when not set.

owner.description: User or team that owns this vault.

storage_root.description: Root directory for source files managed by this vault. Absolute path. Must be outside cloud-synced directories.

brain_root.description: Directory containing this vault's content store and graph store databases. Absolute path. Must be outside cloud-synced directories (SQLite and LanceDB are incompatible with cloud sync).

members.description: Users with access to this vault. Each entry specifies a user and their vault-level role.

user_id.description: Reference to a registered SAGE User entity.

role.description: Vault-level role. Distinct from document-level editor permissions.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/Chicago') used to derive document_date from source_modified_at when no filename or caller-supplied date is available. Defaults to UTC.

document_types.description: Document type definitions for this vault's domain vocabulary.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state machine configuration for this vault.

edge_inference.description: Edge inference tier assignments and rules.

access_control_defaults.description: Default access control settings for new documents in this vault.

new_documents_restricted.description: If true, new documents are created with the ingesting user as the sole editor. If false (default), new documents are open (no editors registered, any registered user can write).

abstraction.description: Configuration for the semantic abstract generation stage of the ingestion pipeline (CAS-ADR-011).

enabled.description: Whether to generate semantic abstracts during ingestion. If false, ingestion completes with pipeline_status 'abstraction_skipped'. If true and the LLM fails at runtime, pipeline_status is 'failed' (strict quality gate).

model.description: LLM model identifier for abstract generation. Should be a local model for Phase 1.

max_abstract_tokens.description: Upper bound on abstract length in tokens. Actual length is density-proportional.

base_abstract_tokens.description: Minimum token floor for the density-proportional abstract budget. Combined with tokens_per_word as `min(base_abstract_tokens + word_count * tokens_per_word, max_abstract_tokens)` to set the per-document budget.

tokens_per_word.description: Per-word scaling factor for the density-proportional abstract budget. Combined with base_abstract_tokens as `min(base_abstract_tokens + word_count * tokens_per_word, max_abstract_tokens)` to set the per-document budget.

retrieval_health.description: Configuration for retrieval health smoke tests (eval_retrieval endpoint).

assertions_file.description: Path to a YAML file containing retrieval health assertions, relative to the domain configuration directory. Each assertion specifies a query, an expected document ID, and a top-k threshold.

timing.description: Per-vault query-timing instrumentation configuration (T-0073). Enables structured timing records on the storage, content, and retrieval layers, written to a per-vault rotating log file under brain_root.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, mcp_init wires the no-op timer to all services and the per-vault timing.log is never opened.

log_path.description: Absolute path for the per-vault timing log. When null (default), mcp_init resolves to {brain_root}/timing.log.

emit_threshold_ms.description: Fast-path skip threshold. Measurements below this are not formatted or logged individually; they bump a per-label counter that the periodic summary record consolidates.

warn_threshold_ms.description: Measurements above this are logged at WARNING; otherwise at DEBUG. Configurable per-vault so test cases can drive the WARN path on fast queries by lowering it.

summary_interval_seconds.description: Period at which the background flusher emits a summary record containing the per-label suppressed counts accumulated since the previous flush.
